# Balance table (generated by tests/unit/balance.test.ts)

Deterministic simulation, 60 seeds per cell, using the real enemy data. "Skilled" models a human who perfect-guards 35% / good-guards 35% of chains, uses items sensibly and the Rage/Combo systems. Levels are the intended party level at that story point (XP model in docs/GAME_DESIGN.md). This is a simulation of a scripted bot, not a human playtest.
